title: Routine tag soak failed on a dev deploy 502 and printed an empty FAILED line
summary: An echopoint deploy (Deploy Router 44793938980) started five minutes into the routine's first tag soak. Dev Traefik answered 502 while a task stopped, and `Integration steps need the plan` failed on `update-ok`. run_suites.sh then read the flow's newest execution, which the gate had created two minutes later and passed, and printed `FAILED` with no message; its leak check would have read the same wrong run. This regresses the 2026-11-07 overlap row: `gate_wait` covers gates that start before a tag, not deploys that start during one. run_suites.sh now reads the execution it launched (`exec_of`) and reruns a 50x in an overlapped tag after its leak check.

impact.text: No customer impact. One soak flow failed; no resource leaked. Prod showed no 5xx during its own deploy.

trigger: Deploy Router 44793938980 replaced dev echopoint tasks at 18:34 UTC during the soak.
detection: run_suites.sh printed `GATE-OVERLAP` and an empty `FAILED` line at ~18:40 UTC; the routine read the tag log.
resolution: Soak 2 passed 101/101 on the new build. run_suites.sh changed the same run.

events.label: Soak 1 starts after gate_wait finds no run
Gate runs the same flow; its run is the newest
run_suites.sh prints GATE-OVERLAP and an empty FAILED
Soak 2 passes 101/101 on the new build

whys.problem: A routine soak reported a failure that was not a product regression, with no error message

because.text: `update-ok` got 502 while Swarm replaced a dev echopoint task
because.evidence: Traefik access log 18:34:34 `/flows/5a3b…` 502; router `Deploy echopoint to dev` 18:33:51-18:34:45

because.text: The deploy started after gate_wait returned; no wait before a tag prevents a later deploy
run_suites.sh reran only transport and lease failures, so a deploy-window 5xx failed the soak
Dev Traefik still routed to a stopping task during a start-first rollout; prod showed none
The FAILED line was empty and the leak check pointed at the wrong run
because.evidence: `flows execution list` items[0] = 01a1fa3e… completed (gate, 18:36:27); failed run 01a1fa3c…

because.text: `fail_err` and `leaks` took `execution list` items[0]; the gate ran the flow 2 min later in the same org
run_suites.sh identified a failed run as the flow's newest execution, which breaks whenever the gate runs the same flow

well: GATE-OVERLAP flagged the overlap, so the cause was found from one log line.
wrong: The empty FAILED line looked like the 2026-11-11 launch-timeout case and pointed the wrong way.
lucky: The failed run's cleanups completed; a leak there would have been checked against the gate's green run and missed.

actions.what: `exec_of`: fail_err and leaks read the execution the script launched
`DEPLOY-OVERLAP-RERUN`: rerun once a 502/503/504 in a tag a deploy overlapped, after the leak check
Find why dev Traefik routes to a stopping echopoint task in start-first rollouts (prod clean)

messaging.internal: Soak false failure from a deploy overlap; run_suites.sh now reads its own execution and reruns deploy-window 5xx.
